what: Compass is America's largest residential estate agency by sales volume. It recruits agents, gives them technology and marketing tools, and takes a share of each commission.
customers: Home buyers and sellers, through its agents, concentrated in expensive coastal markets.
money: a share of the commission on each home sale
moat: A technology platform agents actually prefer, which has let it recruit top producers from established brokerages, and that is how market share is won in residential property.
risks: Home sales volumes are at multi-decade lows because of mortgage rates
Antitrust settlements changed how commissions are set and shared, which may compress them
71 times earnings with a slim operating margin
opportunities: $294M of free cash flow and revenue up from $4.9B to $7.0B in two years
Analysts see about 25% upside, with 12 covering the stock
The Anywhere Real Estate acquisition would make it far larger and bring cost savings
watch: Agent count and market share, which grow even when transaction volumes do not.
